message.description: The user message to send to ChatGPT.

browser_server_url.description: Optional browser server base URL from the executor side. Default auto-detects http://127.0.0.1:5001 first.

executor_url.description: Optional executor_server.py base URL. Leave empty to use EXECUTOR_URL or common reachable executor URLs.

executor_token.description: Optional executor_server.py bearer token. Leave empty to use EXECUTOR_TOKEN or the standard local executor token.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait without response progress before timing out. Default 180.

stability_checks.description: Consecutive identical assistant reads required before treating the answer as finished. Default 2.

max_total_seconds.description: Absolute cap for the relay call in seconds. Default 600.
